blocks.text: Check our Miss International 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features TOKYO — Elizaveta Kuznetsova of Moldova has been crowned as Miss International 2026 during the pageant’s Final Gala held at the Kanadevia Hall (formerly Tokyo Dome City Hall) in Tokyo, Japan, on Wednesday evening, Nov. 25. Kuznetsova bested 72 other delegates from different countries and territories around the world, including the Philippines’ Katrina Johnson, who finished in the Top 20.
